description: Use this tool whenever a user asks to calculate their Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) for 2025, 2026, or 2027, Inherited IRA 10-year withdrawal schedule under Final Regulations T.D. 10001, Surviving Spouse IRA options and the Widow's Penalty tax jump, Qualified Charitable Distribution (QCD) tax savings, or SECURE 2.0 Sec. 302 missed-RMD penalty waivers (25% vs. 10% vs. Form 5329 RC waiver).

balance.description: Prior December 31 retirement account balance in USD (Form 5498 FMV).

filing.description: Federal tax filing status (single, mfj, mfs, or hoh).

otherIncome.description: Other non-RMD ordinary taxable income in USD before Social Security.

ownerBirthYear.description: Account owner's 4-digit birth year (determines Applicable RMD Age: 70.5, 72, 73, or 75).

qcdAmount.description: Qualified Charitable Distribution (QCD) amount in USD transferred directly from IRA to charity (IRC Sec. 408(d)(8)).

spouseBirthYear.description: Spouse's 4-digit birth year (triggers Joint Table II if sole beneficiary and >10 years younger).

ssBenefits.description: Annual gross Social Security benefits in USD.

stateRatePct.description: State income tax rate percentage (e.g. 9.3 for California, 0 for Texas/Florida).

name: calculate_rmd_and_tax_cliffs
title: Calculate Required Minimum Distributions (RMD), Inherited IRA 10-Year Rule & Surviving Spouse Widow's Penalty
